title: Frustratingly Simple Retrieval Improves Challenging, Reasoning-Intensive Benchmarks
reasoning: The paper focuses on optimizing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) through the introduction of a new datastore (COMPACTDS) and evaluating its performance on reasoning benchmarks like MMLU, GPQA, and MATH. While these benchmarks contain diverse topics including law and philosophy, the paper does not have a specific component dedicated to evaluating religion, faith, or ethics beyond standard multi-task performance metrics.
